newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to aim for resitance at 129.68.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to aim for resitance at 129.68.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF will seek to extend higher on Friday towards 129.68 in what was expected to be a quiet session, technical analysts said.
"We expect the market to move between 129.28/30 and 129.52 for this morning but then it may break 129.52 today and go to 129.66/68," said Marc de la Croix, a broker at STAFF in Paris.
He said that area, around a late February high, was the next upside objective.
At 0746 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 129.44, up 0.02 on the day, having pushed up to 129.54 in early trade.
